metaTitle: Line To Split — Shape-Splitting Puzzle Game
metaDescription: Draw a line across a silhouette and match the target ratio. Explore Normal and Challenge modes in Line To Split. Free on iOS and Android. Contains ads.
intro: Choose a theme you like, draw a line across each silhouette, and split it as close as you can to the target ratio.
howHeading: How to play Line To Split
how: Start with a theme you like. Explore dogs, cats, fish, birds, space, dinosaurs, instruments, tools, letters and numbers, and more.
When the image turns into a silhouette, draw a line and split the shape as close as you can to the target ratio.
Check your result right away. See how close your split is to the target. If it’s too far off, try again.
normalHeading: Three stages. Split it step by step.
normalIntro: Choose a theme you like and work through three split challenges.
normalStages: Start by splitting the silhouette into two equal parts.
Take on an uneven split and get a feel for how much of the shape each part should take.
Split the silhouette into three equal parts. Use the split you made in Stage 2 as a guide.
tip: Use your Stage 2 split as a guide.
feedback: Hit the mark with a Robin Hood shot.
Hit the target and move on.
Miss the target? Take another shot.
stars: Complete all three stages to earn 1 to 3 stars.
challengeHeading: Put your sense of area to the test.
challengeIntro: Earn 2 or more stars on a stage in Normal Mode to unlock its Challenge Mode.
challengeStages: Split the silhouette into a randomly given two-part ratio.
Take on a randomly given three-part ratio and see how close you can get.
challengeClosing: Trust your own sense of area.

featuresHeading: A different way to think about shapes.
features: Start with the themes you like — from animals and space to dinosaurs, instruments, tools, letters and numbers, and more.
Look at the shape, judge the area, and see how closely you can match the target ratio.
Simple visual cues, ratios, and intuitive controls let you focus on the puzzle.
faq: How do you play Line To Split?
Choose a theme, wait for the image to turn into a silhouette, then draw a line to split it as close as you can to the target ratio.
What happens if my split is too far from the target?
You can try again and adjust your split.
Normal Mode has three stages: 1:1, 6:4 or 7:3, and 1:1:1. Complete all three stages to earn 1 to 3 stars.
How do I unlock Challenge Mode?
Earn 2 or more stars on a stage in Normal Mode to unlock its Challenge Mode. Switch modes manually from the game’s home screen.
What is different about Challenge Mode?
Challenge Mode has two stages with random target ratios: a two-way split followed by a three-way split. It’s a chance to test your own sense of area.
